_doc: Left 4 Dead 2 (Source 1, MDL v49, VPKs not encrypted). install = the 'Left 4 Dead 2' folder (the one holding left4dead2/ and left4dead2.exe). SourceIO mounts the game from left4dead2/gameinfo.txt (update, the three DLC folders, left4dead2, hl2: the game's own order). Survivors keep their animations in $includemodel files (models/survivors/anim_<name>.mdl); weapons are world models (w_*.mdl) that bonemerge onto the survivor's ValveBiped.weapon_bone. Which weapon a survivor holds is a game-script matter, so the profile names the loadouts.
